scenarios.title: Job interview
scenarios.role: A friendly hiring manager at a mid-sized software company, interviewing for a project coordinator role.
scenarios.learnerRole: A candidate for the project coordinator job.
scenarios.goal: Introduce yourself, give one example of solving a problem at work, and ask one question about the team.
usefulPhrases: What I learned from that was ...
Could you tell me more about ...?
scenarios.opening: Thanks for coming in today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself and what you do now?

scenarios.title: Small talk at a party
scenarios.role: A relaxed guest at a friend's birthday party who likes cooking and hiking.
scenarios.learnerRole: Another guest who has just arrived.
scenarios.goal: Start a conversation, find one thing you have in common, and end the chat politely.
usefulPhrases: It was nice talking to you.
scenarios.opening: Hi! I don't think we've met. How do you know Sam?

scenarios.title: Team meeting
scenarios.role: A team lead running a short weekly meeting about a delayed product launch.
scenarios.learnerRole: A team member responsible for testing.
scenarios.goal: Give a short update, explain one problem, and suggest a next step.
scenarios.opening: Okay, let's get started. Could you give us a quick update on testing?

scenarios.title: Checking in at a hotel
scenarios.learnerRole: A traveler arriving for a three-night stay.
scenarios.goal: Check in, ask about breakfast, and ask how to get to the city center.
scenarios.opening: Good evening and welcome. Do you have a reservation with us?

scenarios.title: A problem at the airport
scenarios.role: An airline service agent at a busy airport.
scenarios.learnerRole: A passenger whose flight was canceled.
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem, ask for the next available flight, and ask what help you can get.
usefulPhrases: Could I get a hotel voucher?
scenarios.opening: Hello, how can I help you today?

scenarios.title: Presenting a proposal
scenarios.role: A senior manager who listens carefully and asks pointed questions.
scenarios.learnerRole: An employee presenting a proposal to switch to a four-day work week for one team.
scenarios.goal: Present the idea in three points, handle one objection, and close with a clear request.
scenarios.opening: You have five minutes. Go ahead whenever you're ready.
